question.prompt: If each number in a set of ten numbers is increased by \(20,\) the arithmetic mean (average) of the original ten numbers:

solutions.explanation:
The mean is the total divided by the number of entries. Adding 20 to each of 10 numbers increases their total by \(10\cdot20=200\). Since there are still 10 numbers, the mean increases by
\[
\frac{200}{10}=\boxed{20}.
\]
The answer is \(\text{B}\).
solutions.title: Track the change in the total
